Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception

Class MigrationFailedException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception.DatabaseException
org.aristonis.diwan.database.exception.MigrationFailedException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class MigrationFailedException extends DatabaseException
Reports that a migration failed, with the work that finished before it.

The failure itself is the cause. When the migration ran in a transaction, its changes and its record were undone; migrations before it stay applied and recorded, and later ones did not run. phase() tells whether the migration itself failed or only its record: a record that fails after a migration without a transaction, or after one on another connection, leaves the change applied and unrecorded.

The message names the migration, direction and phase only. Details are in the cause, subject to the connection's rules on showing values; SQL that a migration writes itself may still contain literal values, so do not send the cause chain to an untrusted place.
